meta.note: The Behance project is the visual authority. These technical component names are reconstructed for development.

interaction_rules.primary_action: Use one dominant scheduling/contact action per viewport.
interaction_rules.cards: Avoid overly commercial e-commerce styling; cards should feel informational and reassuring.
interaction_rules.forms: Use visible labels, clear validation, explicit privacy consent and large touch targets.
interaction_rules.motion: Prefer subtle opacity/translate transitions; avoid fast parallax or distracting motion.
interaction_rules.mobile: Keep contact/booking action reachable without hiding professional credentials.
